name: StreetSpot Agent
description: Provides public information about StreetSpot, a local discovery platform for vendors, pop-up shops, businesses, events, and community spots. This informational agent does not perform external account actions.

skills.name: StreetSpot overview
skills.description: Explain StreetSpot's public platform features and direct users to official resources.

skills.name: Support routing
skills.description: Direct account-specific or unresolved support questions to official StreetSpot support.
